subject.title: feat: Plugin API for TUI footer status contributions (registerStatusProvider)

question: Should OpenClaw add a public PluginStatusProvider/registerStatusProvider SDK seam now, and should the API-only seam land before final TUI footer rendering is designed?
rationale: The request fits the plugin-extension direction, but adding a public Plugin SDK method commits OpenClaw to naming, return shape, multiplicity, and future rendering semantics that automation should not decide.

options.title: Review the API-only PR
options.body: Refresh and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/72557, then land it if the method shape and API-only boundary are acceptable.

options.title: Defer behind footer design
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/53774 settles footer ordering, truncation, theming, and placement semantics.

options.title: Reject the core seam
options.body: Close the core API direction and ask ContextClaw to keep status visibility outside OpenClaw until a different extension surface is approved.

recommendation.title: Review the API-only PR
recommendation.body: Refresh and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/72557, then land it if the method shape and API-only boundary are acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the listed project decision owner and authored the foundational plugin architecture commit this SDK seam would extend.
